assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero, NovaSeq 150x150) of C2C12 myotubes only (S2.6.p2); in vivo mouse arms (PBS/STEM x CON/HU/Recovery, S2.1.p1) were analysed by histology, mass and grip strength only, not sequenced
primary_estimand: Transcriptional effect of 24 h 4% STEM secretome vs 4% horse serum (control) in differentiated C2C12 myotubes (S2.6.p2, S3.4.p1, Fig. 8B). No exercise or training factor exists anywhere in the study; the in vivo loading manipulation is hindlimb unloading (disuse) and 7-day ambulatory reloading, and those animals were not sequenced.
sample_inclusion: 6 replicate wells per arm (12 samples) per GEO; paper S2.6.p1 states 6 replicates per condition
planned_contrasts: STEM vs horse serum in C2C12 myotubes (S3.4.p1, Fig. 8B; DEG count not stated in the text, top-20 up/down table in Fig. 8B)
paper_results: Named genes regulated by STEM: Igfbp3, Col23a1, Col14a1, Mt2, Mt1, Fmod (S3.4.p1); total DEG count not given in the text
